title: play-audio-file~
description: `play-audio-file~` is an abstraction that makes it easier to load and play a sound file from RAM. Send a bang to start playback, `stop` to stop it, `open` with a filename to load another file, or `speed` with a value to set playback speed; its optional arguments are the sound-file name and playback speed, and it outputs a bang when the file ends.
